scenes.title: Datadog for Claude Cowork. Observability by conversation.
scenes.body: The Datadog plugin and connector let Claude query Datadog logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and monitors through the Datadog MCP Server.
scenes.narration: The Datadog plugin and connector let Claude query Datadog logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and monitors through the Datadog MCP Server.
claims: The Datadog MCP Server bridges Datadog observability data to AI agents, so logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and monitors can be queried in natural language.
For Claude, including Claude Cowork, the official Datadog connector is the recommended path and includes MCP Apps for in-product visualizations.
Claude Code installs the Datadog plugin from the official Anthropic Plugin Marketplace; the plugin bundles the MCP Server with skills and auto-updates.
Setup asks you to choose a Datadog site and sign in with OAuth in the browser; API and application keys are a supported alternative.
Remove any separately registered Datadog MCP server or custom connector first to avoid conflicts.
You need Datadog permissions for the resources you query, and the plugin states that no Datadog credentials are sent to the AI model provider.
Groups of MCP tools can be enabled or disabled with the toolsets command.
The Datadog plugin and its marketplace listing are in Preview.
The Datadog MCP Server is HIPAA-eligible, customers remain responsible for the compliance of the AI tools they connect, and the server is not supported on the Datadog government sites.
